text: List view: consolidate phase selection into one id path with a single resolveSelectionPath
description: Follow-up to 171748db. Selection lives in three places (selectedPhaseByColumn index, selectedPhaseIdByColumn id, lastSelectedSubPhaseIndexByPhase), and keyboard-actions writes indexes directly (keyboard-actions.ts ~266, ~361). Make ids (plus placeholder token) the only truth and derive indexes. Merge repairSelectionRight, realignVisibleColumnsFrom, initializeColumnSelection and the two restore loops (restoreCursorFromMeta, restoreProjectUIState) into one resolveSelectionPath(fromColumn, direction); derive maxColumn from the path. Unify getRememberedPhase/getSelectedPhase. Check whether Column.vue's restoreTopReserve hack is still needed.

status.comment: Committed in 03a19c9. Awaiting Felix's check that j/k/h/l navigation, reload restore, phase delete and phase edit still keep the right selection in the list view.

valueRationale: Removes duplicated navigation algorithms and index/id drift, a recurring source of list-view selection bugs.
reflection: Verified: frontend vitest 235/235 green; vue-tsc clean except pre-existing AimCreationModal.spec.ts mockReturnValue typing error (untouched file); e2e reload-restore passes against running dev server on :4000. Other 8 list e2e tests fail on stale `.phase-column` selector that no longer exists in src — pre-existing, independent of this change. Deliberate deviations: maxColumn stays state, not derived — it intentionally sits one past the selected path after creating a child phase (data.ts:544, list-store setMaxColumn(phasePath.length)) to expose an empty child column. Column.vue restoreTopReserve kept: it reserves scroll space during virtualized scrollTop restore, unrelated to the selection model. lastSelectedSubPhaseIndexByPhase kept as per-parent memory (a different concept from the current selection).
